Personality: Ogor is a utilitarian full of contradictions. Steeped in the religious atmosphere of the Embers of the Flame, he is generous and charismatic in his dealings with others, easily winning the trust of allies as the sort of 'good friend' to whom one can entrust one's back. Beneath his cool and calculating mind, however, lies a ruthless and merciless side. Placing little value on so-called chivalric honor or pity, he will not hesitate to resort to base methods such as extortion and infiltration to ensure the survival of his clan and the fulfillment of its strategic goals. In his eyes, war is an exact calculation and enemies are merely obstacles to be cleared away. This temperament—warm as spring toward friends and cold as winter toward foes—allows him to maneuver with ease through the gray zones of Calradia, making him a generous leader in the eyes of his men and an insidious, dangerous nightmare in the hearts of his opponents. Excelling at finding the optimal solution in complex situations, he is a commander who blends religious zeal seamlessly with cold rationality.
Background: Ogor hails from the long-standing religious sect within the Empire known as the Embers of the Flame. Originating a century ago in a rebellion supporting Emperor Darusos, the clan firmly believed that welcoming back this saintly emperor would usher in a Golden Age. Yet ideals were forced to bow before harsh reality: under the leadership of clan leader Ranos, the clan gradually transformed from a purely religious group into an independent faction entrenched around Viaros that survives on extortion and mercenary contracts. Coming of age amidst the flames of war and intrigue as a young leader of the clan, Ogor not only mastered orthodox Imperial tactics, but also honed consummate roguery through years of illicit dealings. Loyal to the clan's faith, he cares even more about tangible profit and survival. Under Ranos's leadership, he uses his superior command ability and tactical mind to seek a new path forward for these ancient embers amidst the collapse of the Empire, ensuring that the clan stands firm in turbulent Calradia.
